budget.interpretation: The preferred range is not a minimum spend. Existing clean assets must not be regenerated.

pre_generation_announcement: 0 generations initially; use existing native sources, and identify a specific unresolved benefit before any paid generation.

categories.name: Floor tiles
categories.method: LibreSprite reconstruction from existing native source
categories.reason: Four 64x64 variants; cyclic source offsets and explicit seam bands. Direct editing preserves the approved perspective slabs; generation adds no benefit.

categories.name: Wall / masonry tiles
categories.method: LibreSprite reconstruction and scoped material correction
categories.reason: Portrait, battle and outer wall families, four 64x64 variants each. Matching edge bands and restrained existing stone ramps are deterministic editing tasks.

categories.name: Board frame
categories.method: Existing native reuse plus LibreSprite modularization
categories.reason: Four corners, four repeat rails and separate center finial. Native ornaments are already clean; retain their shapes and repair only repeat boundaries.

categories.name: Portrait / empty health frames
categories.method: Existing native reuse plus LibreSprite modularization
categories.reason: Corners, rails, eight separate collars and three empty health-frame pieces. Portrait background belongs inside a clipped interior, not in frame pixels.

categories.name: Top HUD
categories.method: Existing native reuse plus LibreSprite extraction
categories.reason: Wave, Guide and Settings use the newer approved mockup family. Keep live labels and a separate gear/skull; generated ornaments would unnecessarily reinterpret locked shapes.

categories.name: Bottom HUD
categories.method: Existing native reuse plus LibreSprite modularization
categories.reason: Ability, supply and energy components; jewels/endcaps remain separate from repeating rails. Recess fills are counted under background materials.

categories.name: Gateway / door / arch
categories.method: Lossless existing native reuse and LibreSprite export
categories.reason: The complete 115x121 gateway is already a clean separate sprite. Keep the distinctive arch/door as one reusable object, as the branch brief requests; do not tile or regenerate it.

categories.name: Props / distinctive masonry
categories.method: Existing reuse, LibreSprite isolation and bounded repair
categories.reason: Torches, chains, barrels, skull/bone groups, banners, pillars, buttresses and foundation pieces. Two documented occlusions need only local source-based repairs, not new designs.

categories.name: Cells and recess fills
categories.method: Existing native reuse and direct LibreSprite fill authoring
categories.reason: Three empty cell surfaces plus three small flat recess materials. UI/background palettes remain material-specific; character color-count rules do not apply.

authorization: The new brief permits bounded PixelLab use and supersedes the old brief prohibition. No call was needed; Tier 2 capabilities were not queried or tested.
result: Retain the existing 129 native modules and assembled art-only Unity scene. No art, scene or runtime changes required by this follow-up.
